description: What scripts/run-tests.mjs does not run from test/*.mjs (RR-46). A new Node test needs no entry; add a file here only when it is a helper, fixture or harness, or a test that another step runs (font-licenses.mjs runs in check:fonts). Files named *-browser*.mjs are browser suites (test/browser-suites.json, scripts/quarantine.mjs) and are skipped by name. RR-53: contractExclude lists the tests the contract suite (npm run test:contract, run by core's pull-request tier) leaves out, each with its reason; every other test of the full run is in the contract.

contractExclude.aptos-preview.mjs: Intos metric-compatibility constants of this package (no core input); full run only.
contractExclude.extra-lazy-fonts.mjs: Host-served lazy font loading and hash validation, renderer internal; the examples are only a loop input.
contractExclude.latin-family-hosts.mjs: Per-family Latin font host fixtures: renderer font registry and advances against the fixture model.
contractExclude.lazy-face-fallback.mjs: Lazy script-face loading and glyph fallback of the renderer for the Aptos scheme.
contractExclude.pdf-vector-visual.mjs: Appearance of the vector PDF writer; the raster golden already renders the same core examples.
contractExclude.pdf-vector.mjs: Structure of the vector PDF writer (text extraction, tagging, embedding), renderer internal.
contractExclude.published-core-gate.mjs: Version arithmetic of the CI gate on opf.requiresUnreleasedCore (RR-55); package machinery, no core input.
contractExclude.raster-script-clusters.mjs: Cluster-by-cluster raster text path of the renderer, no core input.
